name: S14c_0D Ban an thu Sau
description: S14c We Talked About This (bản da đen), ảnh mẫu bàn ăn tối thứ Sáu: sửa từ ảnh 0C đã chọn, cùng góc máy, cùng chỗ ngồi, đồ thứ Sáu, không trang trí sinh nhật. Tải ảnh vào: IMG_MASTER_A_BDAY = ảnh đã chọn của node MASTER_A_BDAY ở S14c_0C; IMG_CS_GLORIA_3 = ảnh đã chọn của node CS_GLORIA_3 ở S14c_0B; IMG_CS_TERRANCE_3 = ảnh đã chọn của node CS_TERRANCE_3 ở S14c_0B; IMG_CS_JADA_2 = ảnh đã chọn của node CS_JADA_2 ở S14c_0B; IMG_CS_WIFE = ảnh đã chọn của node CS_WIFE ở S14c_0A; IMG_ACA_SET = ảnh thật. Chạy sau 0B và 0C. Chọn 1 ảnh: cùng góc máy, cùng 7 người ở đúng ghế như ảnh 0C, mặc đồ thứ Sáu, không băng rôn, bóng bay, túi quà, không lọ hoa giữa bàn, trên khăn ở tủ buffet không quá 6 món gỗ; tải về, ảnh này tải vào node IMG_MASTER_A_FRI ở F5.

nodes.prompt: Image 1 is the chosen photo of the birthday dinner, taken from the main camera at the foot of the table with everyone in their own chair. Image 2 is the grandmother's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain, jewelry and clothes. Image 3 is her son's character sheet: use it only for his face, skin tone, haircut, beard and clothes. Image 4 is the granddaughter's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone, braids, earrings and clothes. Image 5 is the son's wife's character sheet: use it only for her face, skin tone and hair. Image 6 is the real product photo: the wooden serving spoon and the pieces on the towel are these utensils, matte deep-brown acacia with a small hanging hole near the end of each handle; a few of them lie on the towel, never more than six. Edit Image 1 into the same table on a Friday night two weeks later, seen from exactly the same camera. Keep exactly as in Image 1: the camera position, lens and framing, the walls, the archway, the carved wooden fork and spoon, the framed family photos, the china hutch, the chandelier and its warm light, the table with the lace tablecloth and the chairs, and every person in the same chair; there is no flower centerpiece on the table, as in Image 1. Change only: the birthday banner, the gold 7 and 1 balloons, the gift bags and the crystal dish are gone; through the archway, plain brown cardboard moving boxes, unprinted and unlabeled, with no brand marks stand stacked in the hallway. On the sideboard, where the gift bags stood at the birthday, lies the red-and-white checkered towel with a few pieces of the wooden set on it, never more than six, and nothing else. On the table: a plate of food, cutlery and a drinking glass at every place; bowls of collard greens and candied sweet potatoes and a basket of cornbread; no potato salad on the table yet. The grandmother: a 71-year-old Black American woman with medium-deep brown skin and warm undertones, a round face, short tapered silver-white coily hair, gold-framed reading glasses hanging on a chain at her chest, small gold earrings and a small gold cross. She wears a burgundy sweater, small gold earrings and the same floral cotton apron. She stands at the head of the table beside her own chair, holding a large glass bowl of homemade potato salad (potatoes, chopped egg, celery, relish, a light dusting of paprika on top) with the wooden serving spoon of the set in it. Her son: a 46-year-old Black American man with deep brown skin, a low taper fade with a little grey at the temples, a neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, a tense jaw and a gold wedding band. He wears a plaid button-down shirt. He sits in his chair beside the head of the table. The granddaughter: a 19-year-old Black American woman with medium brown skin, long knotless braids gathered in a low ponytail, small gold hoop earrings and a bright, expressive face. She wears a green knit sweater. She sits right next to her father; her own water bottle stands on the table just beyond her plate, on the side away from her father: a large light-pink insulated tumbler with a handle, a lid and a straw, plain, with no logo or lettering. The son's wife: a 44-year-old Black American woman with light-medium brown skin and natural hair in a neat high bun. She wears a soft rust-orange knit sweater instead of her dinner outfit. She sits on the other side, opposite her husband, next to the head of the table. The aunt, the grandmother's younger sister, about 66: a Black American woman with medium-brown skin, a round face and shoulder-length silver-grey natural hair in soft twists; she wears a navy cardigan over a cream blouse. The uncle, the aunt's husband, about 70: a Black American man with deep brown skin, a bald head and a short white beard; he wears a brown V-neck sweater over a collared shirt. Between the son's wife and the uncle, only the boy's small hands and blue hoodie sleeves show; the rest of him is hidden behind the uncle. Only these seven people are at this dinner: the grandmother, her son, his wife, the granddaughter, the boy, the aunt and the uncle; no other guests, no other children, nobody else in the room. Everyone is quiet and a little uneasy, waiting; nobody smiles; everyone's eyes stay off-lens. Every hand has five fingers in natural proportion and a natural grip; each person has exactly two arms and two hands; nothing floats. Look: warm evening light from a small chandelier, soft shadows, warm family-film color. Skin as a real camera sees it from a couple of meters away: natural, with subtle texture and slight unevenness, not retouched, not over-detailed; no airbrushed, waxy or plastic skin. Brown skin true to life: each person keeps their own skin depth and undertone, with soft natural highlights and visible detail in the shadows; palms lighter than the backs of the hands; never grey, ashy or lightened. looking like an ordinary frame from a real camera with a normal lens, not a render; true-to-life gentle colors and soft natural contrast; fine natural grain; the far background a touch softer than the foreground. No over-sharpening, no HDR, no CGI look. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no logos. Final check: the same room, camera and seats as in Image 1, with no birthday decorations; the grandmother is the same woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone, silver hair, glasses on the chain and gold jewelry; her son is the same man as in his character sheet, with the same skin tone, haircut and beard; the granddaughter is the same young woman as in her character sheet, with the same skin tone and braids; the son's wife is the same woman as in her character sheet; seven people at the dinner, each in the chair listed.
